title: The Formal letter to the office
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：formal　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 formal 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the painter wrote of ① a formal letter to the office in the catalogue, and everybody in the studio said at once that it was ② so formal that nobody in the studio would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the painter, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the formal ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the formal letter to the office that anybody there had ever seen, or so the catalogue for May 1967 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too formal to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the formal ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a formal dinner at the hall, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as formal as the dinner at the hall they had once had in the old studio. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was formal or not, and he said so.

By 1980 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue. What the line asked for was ⑦ something formal, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next studio called the whole plan ⑧ quite formal; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the catalogue kept the names of the formal ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1983, year after year, she wrote of another formal letter to the office in the same catalogue, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less formal than anybody had expected. ⑩ The formal dinner at the hall that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1985, was the one she could never quite name; the formal ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 正式（前置定语 a formal letter to the office：1973 年画师在展品目录里记下的那件正式的信函）
B. adj. 正式／拘谨（两处加强说法：so formal that … 与 no less formal than …）
C. adj. 正式／拘谨（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 正式（表语 too formal to do：母亲觉得它太正式，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 拘谨（前置定语 a formal dinner at the hall：叔叔把整件事称作一桩拘谨的正式晚宴）
F. adj. 拘谨（同级比较 as formal as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩厅里的正式晚宴相比）
G. adj. 拘谨（后置定语 something formal：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 拘谨（受程度副词修饰 quite formal：那位观者的评价）

items.q: a formal letter to the office
the formal letter to the office that
a formal dinner at the hall
The formal dinner at the hall that

answers.why: formal 意为“正式”，1973 年画师在展品目录里记下的是“一件正式的信函”，此处作前置定语 a formal letter to the office。
formal 意为“正式”，此处用 so formal that 结构，说它正式到画室里没人敢靠近。
formal 意为“正式”，展品目录上 五月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的正式给办公室的正式信函，等于最高级的说法。
formal 意为“正式”，母亲认为这件东西“太正式了，谁也用不上”，too formal to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
formal 意为“拘谨”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩拘谨的正式晚宴”，此处作前置定语 a formal dinner at the hall。
formal 意为“拘谨”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩厅里的正式晚宴一样拘谨”，同级比较用 as formal as。
formal 意为“拘谨”，展品目录上那半行字要的是“拘谨的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something formal。
formal 意为“拘谨”，邻画室来的那位观者认为这套计划“相当拘谨”，quite 修饰原级 formal。
formal 意为“拘谨”，no less formal than 表示“其拘谨不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之拘谨不亚于任何人的预料。
formal 意为“拘谨”，母亲 1985 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的拘谨正式晚宴”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1973 年，画师在展品目录里记下了一件正式的信函。（a formal letter to the office）
它正式到画室里没有一个人敢靠近。（so formal that …）
母亲觉得它太正式，谁也用不上。（too formal to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩拘谨的正式晚宴。（a formal dinner at the hall）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩厅里的正式晚宴一样拘谨。（as formal as …）
到了 1980 年，展品目录上只剩半行字：要的是一件拘谨的东西。（something formal）
answers: In 1973 the painter wrote of a formal letter to the office in the catalogue.
It was so formal that nobody in the studio would go near it.
My mother thought it too formal to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a formal dinner at the hall.
He said nobody would call it as formal as the dinner at the hall they had once had.
By 1980 the catalogue asked for nothing but something formal.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 formal 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the painter wrote of a formal letter to the office in the catalogue, and nobody forgot it.
It was the formal letter to the office that anybody there had ever seen, or so the catalogue says.
My mother thought it too formal to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a formal dinner at the hall, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next studio called the plan quite formal, and everybody laughed.
The formal ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
